Avoid penalty cards: hearts cost one point each and the queen of spades costs 13. The lowest score wins when someone reaches 100.

Pass three cards left, right, then across; every fourth hand has no pass. Select three cards and choose Pass cards. The two of clubs leads the first trick. Follow suit if possible. The highest card of the led suit wins; aces are high.

Hearts cannot lead until a heart has been discarded, unless your hand contains only hearts. On the first trick you cannot discard points if you have another choice. Taking all 26 points shoots the moon: each opponent receives 26 instead. Click a legal card to play. After thirteen tricks choose Next hand.

The three computer opponents infer hidden cards from play; their memory and strength vary. They do not need a network connection.
